description: Convert a 3D model to glTF (JSON with companion files) using the Trimesh library. The result is always in metres, Y-up. Set the source unit or up axis when the input does not declare them.
inputInstructions:
Converts a 3D model to glTF (.gltf); the converted file and its companion files are written back to the asset. Select the source model as the input file; the converted file is written back to the asset.

The result is always in metres with Y up, the glTF convention, so there are no target options. Source units and Source up axis default to auto: the unit and axis the file declares are used (USD, DAE, 3MF), and a file that declares none (STL, OBJ, PLY, OFF, XYZ) is not scaled or rotated. Set them for a file whose numbers use another unit or axis, for example mm and z for a CAD export.

This pipeline reads no asset or file metadata. Everything it needs comes from the selected file and this template.

tagSchema.label: Source units
tagSchema.description: Unit of the numbers in the source file. auto uses the unit the file declares and applies no scaling to a file that declares none. Set it when the file uses another unit, for example mm for a CAD export. The result is scaled to metres.

tagSchema.label: Source up axis
tagSchema.description: Which axis points up in the source file. auto uses the axis the file declares and does not rotate a file that declares none. Set z for a CAD or 3D-printing export. The result is Y-up.
